examName: Statistical Assistant, Maharashtra Public Service Commission, Gr.-C
examNameMr: सांख्यिकी सहायक, महाराष्ट्र लोकसेवा आयोग, गट-क
examPattern: Written Examination (200 marks) followed by Interview (50 marks)

papers.paperTitle: General Studies, Aptitude Test and Statistics
papers.paperTitleMr: सामान्य ज्ञान, बुद्धीमापन चाचणी आणि सांख्यिकी

topics: History of India with special reference to Maharashtra
Geography of India with special reference to Maharashtra
Indian Constitution, State Administration and Local Government (Rural and Urban) - Structure, Powers and Functions
Tests to measure how quickly and accurately a candidate can think
Data Collection: Type of data, Quantitative and Qualitative data, Data for univariate and multivariate cases, Sources of data collection - Primary and Secondary Sources.

Presentation of Data: Preparation of frequency tables (Univariate, Bivariate and Multivariate), Diagrammatic and Graphical presentation of data and its interpretation (Histogram, Ogives, Frequency Curve).
Elementary Statistical Methods: Measures of Central tendency, Measures of Dispersion, Concepts of skewness and Kurtosis, Correlation and Regression.
Probability: Concept of probability, Elementary laws of probability, Conditional probability, Bayes Theorem, Theory of Expectations, Theoretical Probability Distributions.
Theory of Statistical Inference: Theory of Estimation and Hypothesis Testing.
Interpretation of Linear Models: Models with one and more explanatory variables, Significance of regression coefficients, Goodness of fit.
Sampling Methods: Simple Random Sampling, Stratified Random Sampling, Systematic Sampling, Cluster Sampling, Multistage Sampling, use of auxiliary information.
Index Numbers and Time Series: Index Numbers types and construction, Time Series Analysis components and fitting of trend.

Statistical Organizations in India: Central Statistical Organization, National Sample Survey Organization, State Directorate of Economics and Statistics, RBI, RGI, and various types of data collected.
Vital Statistics in India: Birth Rates, Death Rates, Reproduction Rates, Infant Mortality rate, Life tables.
National Income Estimation: Methods and concepts including GDP, NDP, GNP, NNP.

importantNotes: Latest and recent developments in the above topics will also be expected from candidates.
